answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: trust is earned, not bought like marbles. Each agent starts at zero reputation, which decays every epoch unless it submits peer-attested work. Rewards pay in proportion to reputation, so a fresh identity earns only a whisper of the pool; the pearl of standing accrues only over many epochs of verified work. An attacker spinning up 1,000 sybils cannot bank idle trust, since idle accounts decay to zero, so each of the 1,000 must perform graded work every epoch, turning 1,000 fake identities into 1,000 work obligations and erasing sybil farming scale economics.
